functions.name: admin-control
functions.signal: called from src/lib/adminControl.ts via functions.invoke and probed by src/pages/Status.tsx; issues admin sessions from the server-side ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH secret and holds in-memory rate-limit state

functions.name: mcp
functions.signal: JSON-RPC handler proxied at the fixed /.well-known/mcp and /mcp URLs from middleware.ts and vercel.json; advertised in public/.well-known/mcp

functions.name: public-api
functions.signal: serves the documented /api/v1 JSON API with RFC 9457 errors and RateLimit headers; URL is published in public/openapi.json and llms.txt

functions.name: track-event
functions.signal: no call sites under src/ and no signature check — URL treated as load-bearing until proven otherwise
